properties.note: Union County's 20 voting precincts. The geometry is the Census 2020 voting-district fabric, which sums to the county's exact 2020 population of 17,244; the names are the county's own, taken from its certified returns and identical in the 2024 General (ISBE election 66) and the 2026 General Primary (ISBE election 69). Union County elects its five commissioners county-wide — its own returns count every lettered seat in all twenty precincts — so there is no board district for a precinct to belong to. No polling place is carried, and no roster.
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts under Union County's own precinct names, as its certified returns spell them
